acceptance: Each of the three is fixed or closed with a reason
Any soundness-path change has the required review and a maintainer merge
context: Closed 2026-10-03 with no change. (1) The soundness-flag job was removed from CI in #2558. (2) test_unit_marker_functionality was removed in #2507: it spawned a whole-suite collect-only pytest run (~33,000 tests), and collection is covered by --strict-markers and tests/unit/test_marker_strategy.py. (3) The 600 s visual-baseline wait (ci.yml ~1998, docs.yml ~294) applies only to merge-queue followers. It already polls and returns early (waitForTrustedBaseline: 6 tries at 2 s, then every 60 s), the 60 s interval protects the shared GITHUB_TOKEN budget, and tests/unit/workflows/test_public_site_visual_workflow.py pins it. The design is in _project/decisions/visual-baseline-queue-candidate-2026-09-26.md and the site-equivalent-ancestor record of 2026-09-27.
description: (1) The soundness-flag job diffs from the PR's recorded base to a merge ref on current develop, so a stale base gives a false 'PR body must contain a Soundness review' failure (a soundness path, so it needs the owner). (2) The test_unit_marker_functionality test is a 60 s flake. (3) The 600 s baseline wait in the PR workflow. Each is independent.
